findings.explanation: The invoice billed $225,385.60 for SKU FR-200 but the maximum allowed under the 5% annual escalator cap is $221,205.60, resulting in a $4,180.00 overcharge that exceeds the permitted rate increase and is therefore not chargeable under Section 7.2.

dispute_email.subject: Invoice Dispute – INV-1001 (Corvina Freight Systems LLC) – Overcharge of $4,180.00
dispute_email.body:
Dear Corvina Freight Systems LLC Accounts Receivable Team,

We are writing to dispute Invoice INV-1001, dated 2026-07-10, due to a billing discrepancy identified during our review.

Line item FR-200 was billed at $225,385.60; per the contract, the allowable amount is $221,205.60, resulting in an overcharge of $4,180.00. This charge violates Clause 7.2, which states: "On each anniversary of the Effective Date, Carrier may adjust the unit rates set out in Section 3.2 by no more than five percent (5.0%) of the rate in effect immediately before that anniversary, compounded annually over the Term. A rate increase above the five percent (5.0%) ceiling in any contract year is not chargeable, and Customer may treat any invoice line that applies such an increase as an overcharge." The applied increase exceeds the 5.0% annual escalator ceiling permitted under this clause.

Total overcharge identified on this invoice: $4,180.00.

Please issue a corrected invoice or a credit memo for $4,180.00 to resolve this discrepancy. Kindly confirm receipt of this dispute and provide an expected resolution date.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
Accounts Payable
